blocks.text: CAUAYAN CITY — Two students, aged 7 and 8, died after being electrocuted along with two other children during a Color and Bubble Fun Run at Cauayan South Central School here on Saturday morning (Oct. 3), police said. The fatalities were identified by relatives and witnesses as an 8-year-old Grade 3 pupil, and a 7-year-old girl, who reportedly died at the scene. Investigators said the two other children, aged 9 and 6, were taken to Cauayan Medical Specialist Hospital and Cauayan District Hospital, respectively.
